text:
Minimum Qualifications
We are looking for someone comfortable designing highly available distributed services.
You will have owned production Python services and REST APIs.
At least three years of backend engineering experience.
A bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent experience is required.
Preferred Qualifications
Kubernetes experience is a plus.
AWS certification preferred.

expected.anchor: owned production Python services and REST APIs
three years of backend engineering experience

What you will do
Own batch and streaming pipelines using Python, Spark, and Kafka.
Partner with product and analytics teams to define reliable data contracts.
Qualifications
Experience with SQL and AWS.
At least five years of data engineering experience.
Nice to have: dbt experience.
A computer science degree is not required.
